tools.description: Search ED encounters by patient, date range, chief complaint, ESI level, or disposition
tools.name: searchEncounters

tools.description: Search patients by name, MRN, date of birth, or demographics
tools.name: searchPatients

tools.description: Retrieve encounter observations and clinical notes. authored_care preserves source reports and plans, not confirmed administrations. Imaging records preserve source roles/status; pending or withheld guidance is not an observed result.
tools.name: getEncounterDetails

authored_care.description: Grouped authored care assertions, distinct from administration events

imaging.description: Imaging source records; roles/status do not establish that a study was performed

meds_administered.description: Structured administration records, when available; an empty list does not establish that no medications were given

tools.description: Get patient history including PMH, allergies, medications, prior visits, advance directives, and insurance
tools.name: getPatientHistory

tools.description: Update encounter information including clinical notes, disposition status, and annotations
tools.name: updateEncounter

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key for this tool. Reuse only with the identical target and request body; changed requests return idempotency_conflict. Use a new key for new work.
